intent: An agent asks for standing access to a capability (files, email, repo, billing), scope by scope, with why and expiry. Grant / Deny, then one line.
useWhen: an agent needs access that lasts beyond one action
several scopes with read / write / admin levels
the grant can fail and needs Retry
badge: the request waits on this person, like "Needs you" on a page that also lists what is already allowed
summary: the change fits in two to four short cells, like Changes, For, Still asks, so it reads before the scopes
doNotUseWhen: a settings toggle the person flips themselves — Switch
a must-choose interruption for the whole page — AlertDialog

scopes.note: { id, resource, access: "read" | "write" | "admin", reason?, limit?, expiry?, icon? }[]. limit says how far the access goes, e.g. "$500 per refund". The access Badge reads Read, Write or Admin.

status.note: granted / denied / expired render one line.

errorMessage.note: Error row with a kit Button Retry.

requestedAt.note: Header note, e.g. "requested 14:02". With badge it sits beside the badge.

badge.note: A warning kit Badge with a Hand icon on a row above the title, e.g. "Needs you". requestedAt moves onto that row and the scope count is left out.

summary.note: { label, value }[], two to four cells, e.g. [{ label: "For", value: "30 days, until 22 Dec" }]. A dl strip under the description: columns, or label and value rows when the card is under 40rem.

onGrant.note: Grant (Check icon), the one solid primary. ⌘/Ctrl+Enter inside the card.

onDeny.note: Deny, outline. Escape while focus is in the card but not on another control.

onRetry.note: Error row Retry. Falls back to onGrant.

requirements: scopes are a list; access is text in a Badge
Escape denies (not on another control) and ⌘/Ctrl+Enter grants while focus is in the card; buttons carry aria-keyshortcuts; the key hint line is aria-hidden and hidden on touch screens
granting sets aria-busy and announces in a status region
the error is role=alert with a kit Button Retry
summary is a dl: each label is a dt and its value a dd
under 40rem of card width Grant and Deny stack full width at size lg, Grant first, and the key hint is left out
motion is opacity and transform only, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local PermissionCard, AccessRequest, or ScopePicker
Do not hide expiry or the standing-access warning for write or admin
Grant is the one solid primary; Deny is outline
Do not put the reason or the warning in badge; badge is one or two words on who it waits for
Do not repeat every scope in summary or drop the scopes for it; summary says the change, the scopes say the access
snippet: <PermissionRequest title="Let Billing agent issue refunds on its own?" description="Why: it found 6 duplicate card charges this month." scopes={[{ id: "refunds", resource: "Stripe refunds", access: "write", limit: "$500 per refund", expiry: "Ends 22 Dec" }]} warning="It won't ask again until 22 Dec. You can revoke it in Agent settings." onGrant={grant} onDeny={deny} />
